content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Bitcoin payment

The architecture behind Bitcoin payments for digital downloads is designed to empower creators by providing them with complete ownership over their sales processes. In a landscape where platforms impose hefty fees and control over transactions, this system removes dependency on third-party services. By leveraging a combination of decentralized payment solutions and automated delivery systems, creators can sell their digital products directly to their audience without the burden of platform fees. This shift not only maximizes profits but also promotes financial independence in regions with limited access to conventional payment methods.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At its core, this architecture integrates various technologies to facilitate seamless transactions for digital downloads. Using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, creators can automate product delivery instantly upon payment confirmation. NOWPayments acts as the bridge for processing Bitcoin transactions, charging only 0.5% per transaction, compared to traditional platforms. The system employs a combination of GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, along with a backend logic layer that manages order storage and verification. This infrastructure not only simplifies the sales process but ensures that creators maintain control over their data and revenue.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This payment architecture is specifically built for digital creators in regions where platforms like Stripe and PayPal are either restricted or unavailable. It caters to authors selling ebooks, designers offering templates and fonts, and educators providing online courses. By providing an alternative that eliminates high transactional fees and ensures immediate product delivery, this infrastructure empowers creators to monetize their work effectively. It is tailored for those who seek to maximize their earnings while retaining full ownership of their intellectual property, thus fostering a new era of digital commerce.
Eliminate platform fees and maximize your revenue.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The success of this architecture relies on several key components that work in unison. First, hosting platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages provide reliable and cost-effective hosting solutions for digital products. Next, backend solutions such as Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script automate the logic for order processing and delivery. NOWPayments facilitates the payment process by accepting Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies, ensuring that transactions are secure and cost-effective. Together, these elements create a cohesive system that allows creators to operate their own stores independent of conventional payment platforms.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy this architecture, start by setting up a hosting solution using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, create a backend logic system using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle order management. Integrate NOWPayments for payment processing, ensuring you set up cryptocurrency pricing in USD at transaction time. Load your digital products into the system for sale. Finally, promote your store to your audience, directing them to your products. For a comprehensive guide, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all necessary blueprints and templates to get started quickly.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by using a combination of decentralized hosting and payment solutions. By leveraging platforms like GitHub Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for payment processing, you can retain full control over your sales while significantly reducing transaction fees. This architecture eliminates reliance on traditional payment processors, allowing you to directly reach your audience with your digital products.
Own your digital commerce infrastructure outright.

For a complete overview of our products, visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Start by creating an account on GitHub or Cloudflare for hosting your digital products. Set up your store frontend using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Implement backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for order handling. Integrate NOWPayments to manage Bitcoin transactions. Upload your digital products for sale and configure pricing. Test the entire system to ensure seamless operation. Finally, launch your store and promote it to your audience.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I accept Bitcoin payments for digital downloads?
To accept Bitcoin payments, integrate NOWPayments into your store setup. This service will handle the cryptocurrency transactions and ensure you receive payments securely and efficiently.
What are the costs associated with using NOWPayments?

NOWPayments charges a 0.5% fee on each transaction, which is significantly lower than platforms like Gumroad that charge 10% per sale. This cost-efficiency can lead to substantial savings for creators.
Can I automate delivery of my digital products?
Yes, you can automate delivery using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. This allows your products to be delivered instantly upon payment confirmation, enhancing the customer experience.
What if I need support after setup?
After deploying your store, you can access support for a limited time if you purchase the Sovereign Starter Stack or Edge Commerce Stack, which includes 30 days of assistance.
Is there a limit to how many products I can sell?
No, there is no limit to the number of products you can sell using this architecture. You can scale your offerings as needed without any additional platform fees.
